blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ: اِنَّهُ كَانَ مَعَكَ مَلَكٌ يَرُدُّ عَنْكَ، فَلَمَّا رَدَدْتَ عَلَيْهِ بَعْضَ قَوْلِهِ وَقَعَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَلَمْ اَكُنْ لِأَقْعُدَ مَعَ الشَّيْطَانِ ثُمَّ قََالَ: يَا اَبَا بَكْرٍ ثَلَاثٌ كُلُّهُنَّ حَقٌّ، مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ ظُلِمَ بِمَظْلَمَةٍ فَيُغْضِيْ عَنْهَا لِلّهِ اِلَّا اَعَزَّ اللهُ بِهَا نَصْرَهُ وَمَا فَتَحَ رَجُلٌ بَابَ عَطِيَّةٍ يُرِيْدُ بِهَا صِلَةً اِلَّا زَادَهُ اللهُ بِهَا كَثْرَةً وَمَا فَتَحَ رَجُلٌ بَابَ مَسْأَلَةٍ يُرِيْدُ بِهَا كَثْرَةً اِلَّا زَادَهُ اللهُ بِهَا قِلَّةً.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates, “In a gathering where the Prophet ﷺ was seated, a man abused Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) (he kept on abusing, and seeing Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) remain patient and silent) the Prophet ﷺ was pleased and was smiling. Then, as the man abused him more, Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) replied to some of his words; at this the Prophet ﷺ became angry, got up and left from there. Hazrat Abu Bakr (RA) followed the Prophet ﷺ and asked him, “Ya Rasulallah, as long as he was abusing me you remained seated, then when I began to reply to some of his words you became displeased, got up and left — why?” The Prophet ﷺ said, (as long as you remained silent and patient) “An angel was with you, replying on your behalf. Then as soon as you replied to some of his words (that angel went away and) Shaytan came, and I do not sit with Shaytan” (so I got up and came away). After that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “O Abu Bakr!
